scope: StockService dependency discipline + ChoiceAvailabilityResolver invariants + dashboard controller boundary
evidence_method: Read-verified file:line citations only — no fiction

findings.title: StockService::releaseForOrderInTransaction movementKey seed includes pre-mutation released_qty
findings.evidence: movementKey seed = 'released:' . (int) $orderItem->released_qty . ':delta:' . $deltaLineQty — at the moment of dispatch, the OrderItem is locked (L364-366 lockForUpdate). Across parallel partial refunds, the second one waits on the lock then reads the updated released_qty, so seed differs naturally. No collision.
findings.verdict: PASS — design intentional, lockForUpdate serializes refunds per OrderItem.
findings.scope_minimal_heal: Document the invariant inline (no code change needed).

findings.title: requireOriginalDecrement guard prevents refund-without-prior-decrement
findings.evidence: if ($requireOriginalDecrement && ! StockMovement::query()->where('idempotency_key', $orderKey)->exists()) { continue; } — release path (mutateForOrder direction=+1) sets requireOriginalDecrement=true on L38. Refund called before decrement is silently skipped (no-op).

findings.title: ChoiceAvailabilityResolver::availabilityFromLevel — manual rupture priority documented but no unit sentinel for boundary
findings.evidence: Manual reason (line 281-284) overrides on_hand check. Comment cites F-016a-BIS reasoning. tests/Feature/Stock/StockRuptureAvailabilitySyncTest::test_stock_zero_does_not_override_manual_admin_rupture_reason covers this. CONFIRMED.
findings.scope_minimal_heal: None — heal already present from F-016a-BIS commit.

findings.title: StockRuptureDashboardController duplicates `stockable_name` and `label` in lowAlerts payload
findings.evidence: L83 'label' returns same stockableLabel() value as L82 'stockable_name'. Vue StockLowAlertsWidget L31 prefers `alert.label || alert.stockable_name || ('#' + alert.stockable_id)` — both populated identically, no fallback breaks. Minor payload bloat.
findings.verdict: MINOR — payload duplication, no functional bug.
findings.scope_minimal_heal: Defer to V1.0.2 cleanup. Leave for backwards compat with widget.

findings.title: Stock dashboard component MISSING fr.json hierarchy used by widget (label.stock_low_alerts) — actually OK in fr.json/en.json BUT MISSING in ar.json
findings.anchor: resources/js/languages/ar.json:41-77 (no admin.stock_rupture block) + resources/js/languages/fr.json:77-94 (present) + en.json:77-94 (present, mixed French content L78-93)

Switching to AR locale on /admin/stock/rupture will display raw label keys 'admin.stock_rupture.title' etc. EN file has same keys but uses French strings at L78-93 (locale leak).
